scope: Read-only diagnostics of already-saved development predictions

initial_independent_ideas.idea: Abrupt changes or sparse history may dominate stale T-21 skill estimates.
initial_independent_ideas.assumption: Existing historical summaries miss a useful state-change signal.
initial_independent_ideas.prediction: OOF errors concentrate in sparse-history or long-inactivity groups.
initial_independent_ideas.falsifier: Those groups are no worse, or contain too few errors to matter.
initial_independent_ideas.next_check: Investigate uncertainty-aware dynamics without relaxing T-21.

initial_independent_ideas.idea: Existing learner families may share errors because their input information is similar.
initial_independent_ideas.assumption: Additional independent pre-match information is available.
initial_independent_ideas.prediction: High error intersections limit gains from another small same-feature grid.
initial_independent_ideas.falsifier: Current families disagree widely and useful routing is learnable in early folds.
initial_independent_ideas.next_check: Consider cross-level history or opponent-style representations, evaluated in training folds.

initial_independent_ideas.idea: Probability-loss improvements may improve confidence more than winner ordering.
initial_independent_ideas.assumption: A substantial error share is near the fixed 0.5 decision boundary.
initial_independent_ideas.prediction: R4 changes few classifications or offsets corrections with regressions.
initial_independent_ideas.falsifier: Most errors are confident mistakes, rather than near-boundary errors.
initial_independent_ideas.next_check: Seek new predictive ordering information; monotone symmetric calibration cannot fix accuracy.

R1 ensemble.caution: OOF weights and family configuration choices used OOF labels; meta-training diagnostic, not independent validation.

core_agreement.oracle_caveat: Uses outcomes to pick an already-existing model per match; unattainable diagnostic bound, NOT a fitted model or achievable accuracy claim.
